title: 4521-ESP-AGE-39-62-0006 Nitrogen Heaters (TES hot pump purge)
summary:
- The document is for the specification of nitrogen heaters for a TES hot pump purge project at Solana Generating Station.
- Vendor must provide equipment based on worst-case conditions and meet all applicable codes and standards.
- Performance requirements are detailed in the vendor data sheets, and exceptions must be listed separately.
- Equipment will be installed outdoors without weather protection.
- Six nitrogen electric heaters required, each operating independently.
- Vendor to design and supply all aspects of the nitrogen heaters as per specifications.
- Heaters must handle nitrogen stream and maintain discharge temperature.
- Skids must include heater, piping, control panel, and other components.
- Vendor responsible for sizing heaters based on performance conditions.
- Heaters must be cleaned thoroughly before shipment.
- Maximum allowable pressure loss specified in Data Sheets.
- Materials of construction are specified in Data Sheets.
